summary: RFC 2648 defined the "ietf" URN namespace and some sub-namespaces, and RFC 3553 added "params" with its own registry. No single place listed every sub-namespace under "ietf". This document creates and fills such a registry, changing how new sub-namespaces are added.

plainLanguage.summary: Sub-namespaces under the ietf URN namespace were listed in different places. This RFC creates one registry to list them together and sets a review policy for new entries.

questions: second level urn namespaces under ietf
what is the ietf urn sub-namespaces registry
which sub-namespaces are listed under ietf
subtitle: Creates one IANA registry for sub-namespaces under the IETF URN namespace.

tldr.problem: No single registry listed all sub-namespaces of the ietf URN namespace.
tldr.mechanism: IANA renamed a registry group, added an IETF URN Sub-namespaces registry, and populated it with existing names.
tldr.outcome: The new registry uses IETF Review for adding sub-namespaces and changes the mechanism described in RFC 2648.

today: RFC 6924 is an Informational document that updates RFC 2648. The unit metadata does not list it as obsoleted or updated.

sections.title: A Single List of IETF Sub-namespaces
sections.content:
RFC 2648 defines the ietf URN namespace and several sub-namespaces. RFC 3553 later defines params and a registry for allocations under it, but there was no one registry listing every sub-namespace under ietf.

RFC 6924 creates and populates such a registry. The unit metadata records that it updates RFC 2648.
sections.plainLanguage: The IETF URN namespace had sub-namespaces listed in more than one place. This RFC brings their names together in one registry.

sections.title: The Registry and Its Review Policy
sections.content:
IANA renamed the group to Uniform Resource Name (URN) Namespace for IETF Use, retained the existing params registry, and changed that registry's procedure to IETF Review. IANA also added an IETF URN Sub-namespaces registry with IETF Review as its registration policy.

The new registry is listed first in the group to provide a top-down view of the namespace hierarchy. Its entries include rfc, fyi, std, bcp, id, mtg and params.
sections.plainLanguage: The new registry lists the existing names under ietf. Adding a new sub-namespace requires IETF Review.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content: The RFC describes itself as a procedural document and says it is entirely unrelated to security. Its IANA changes concern registry organization and the process for adding sub-namespaces.
sections.plainLanguage: This RFC changes a registry process. It says the document is unrelated to security.
